title: Recovered craft not made by humanity, confirmed by AARO and the IG
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Recovered craft not made by humanity, confirmed by AARO and the IG, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I am sure there are crafts that were not made by humanity at this current time and place when we recovered them.

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says he is sure the US has recovered craft that were not made by humans. He points for support to AARO, the Pentagon's current office for investigating unexplained sightings, to the Inspector General, an internal government watchdog, and to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has said publicly that such craft exist. If true, it would mean the government holds machines built by someone other than us.
